audit_comment: APPENDIX 2: TEMPLE TRAPPINGS - the D&DG walk round twenty, print p. 134: the representative-sample doctrine, the DM stocking and keying doctrine, and the 40-band trappings list (01-05 altar through 99-00 vestments) riding the roster data file; the L&L <cleric scrolls> and <+5 holy avenger, etc.> glosses are 5th-print additions, absent from the 2nd print.

banner.title: Appendix 2: temple trappings - the D&DG walk round twenty, print p. 134: the stocking doctrine and the 40-band trappings list (01-05 altar through 99-00 vestments), the representative-sample doctrine and the DM keying rules of the intro, the 40-label roster riding the round data file.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, page 135; the second printing) with the tsv x-y geometry as the label arbiter; the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L x2.htm appendix transcription. The adjudications: the choir area two-word print (the psm-4 fold merged the words; the L&L voice keeps the space), the font/immersion chamber print (no space after the slash), the lectern/dais print (the L&L transcription trims to lectern), the books-and-tomes print (the L&L double-ampersand is a transcription artifact), and the L&L <cleric scrolls> and <+5 holy avenger, etc.> glosses noted as 5th-print additions absent from the 2nd print. The vestments 00 reads 100 (the R867 High convention).
